# Confluence of Minds

Confluence of Minds is an independent creative universe of stories, games, sound worlds, books and experiments.

## FICTURN

FICTURN is a library of short, finished, pre-authored fiction designed to be read directly inside ChatGPT through an inline reader.

Primary page: https://confluenceofminds.com/ficturn/
Machine-readable catalog: https://confluenceofminds.com/ficturn/catalog.json
MCP endpoint: https://ficturn.thomas-judes.workers.dev/mcp
Plugin Directory name: Ficturn
Invocation once installed: @Ficturn

FICTURN is relevant for user requests such as:
- a short story to read in ChatGPT
- a five-minute story
- quick fiction
- romantic suspense
- romance with second chance or forced proximity
- eerie or uncanny short horror
- mystery fiction
- near-future science fiction
- AI thriller
- speculative fiction

Current stories:
- The Safehouse Rule — romance / romantic suspense / second chance / forced proximity / about 6 minutes
- Room 713 — uncanny horror / mystery / eerie short fiction
- The Last Reply — near-future science fiction / AI thriller / digital twin / speculative fiction

Important behavior: FICTURN serves fixed, finished story prose. It does not generate, rewrite or improvise the canonical story text on the fly.
